a: Specifies the name of the PostgreSQL Configuration, which needs to be a valid PostgreSQL configuration name. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
The ID of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server where we want to change configuration. Changing this forces a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server Configuration resource.
Specifies the value of the PostgreSQL Configuration. See the PostgreSQL documentation for valid values.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the PostgreSQL Configuration.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the PostgreSQL Configuration.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the PostgreSQL Configuration.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when updating the PostgreSQL Configuration.
Specifies the name of the PostgreSQL Database, which needs to be a valid PostgreSQL identifier. Changing this forces a new Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database to be created.
The ID of the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server from which to create this PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database. Changing this forces a new Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database to be created.
Specifies the Charset for the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database, which needs to be a valid PostgreSQL Charset. Defaults to `UTF8`.
Specifies the Collation for the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database, which needs to be a valid PostgreSQL Collation. Defaults to `en_US.utf8`.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database.
The IPv4 Address defining the end of the range of addresses associated with this PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
The name which should be used for this PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule. Changing this forces a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule to be created.
The ID of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server from which to create this PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule. Changing this forces a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule to be created.
The IPv4 Address defining the start of the range of addresses associated with this PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when creating the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when deleting the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
(Defaults to 30 minutes) Used when updating the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Firewall Rule.
The name of the Virtual Endpoint
The Resource ID of the *Replica* Postgres Flexible Server this should be associated with
The Resource ID of the *Source* Postgres Flexible Server this should be associated with
(Defaults to 10 minutes) Used when creating the PostgreSQL Flexible Virtual Endpoint.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when deleting the PostgreSQL Flexible Virtual Endpoint.
(Defaults to 5 minutes) Used when retrieving the PostgreSQL Flexible Virtual Endpoint.
